title: Hydro Flask Insulated Mug for Coffee, Tea, Hot Chocolate - Leak-Resistant Lid, Keeps Drinks Hot
description:
About this item
INSULATED MUG: The Hydro Flask stainless steel insulated mug keeps drinks hot for hours. Sized for the perfect cup with a closeable, leak-resistant and splash-resistant lid
HOT STAYS HOT: Thanks to the double-wall vacuum insulation, drinks stay hot or cold for hours in this mug. The TempShield insulation ensures the perfect temp, so your drink is always ready for the next sip
LEAK-RESISTANT: The closeable leak-resistant and splash-resistant press-in lid on the insulated Mug keeps drinks ready to sip
SOFT TO THE TOUCH: The soft-touch exterior stays cool and is easy to hold. The ergonomic handle is strong and durable, and ensures a comfy fit."
PURE TASTE: Durable pro-grade stainless steel ensures pure taste and no leftover flavor transfer. So, today's tea have any taste of yesterday's coffee

reviews_5s:
Based on its small size and quality look and feel, it's a great mug if you plan on drinking your hot or cold beverage within in an hour or two.Highly pleased keeps coffee hot for hours, great quality doesn’t leak, well made and reasonably priced not like other more expensive brands, save your money.

Bold beautiful color had to order another one!A great cup my 5th one (they tend to walk away!) comfortable in hand, keeps coffee hot. only complaint, doesn’t fit in a standard vehicle cup holder well.Classy mug. I love the color tooKeeps your coffee or tea hot for hours and the color is very pleasing in my opinion!Good cupI have an older version of this that i would use camping and when my father visited he loved it for every day use. I had to order one for him and he was delighted that the lid had a closure in the updated version. Keeps his coffee warm. Only thing i wish I could do would be adding a photo to it.Que le gustóI bought fossil colour which is more like a yellow mustard colour than the bright yellow I was hoping for. I bought it on sale (S$27) so can’t complain too much.

I have an insulated mug that’s much larger and with no handle, which I find annoying when I walk around and need to hold multiple things. So I bought this mug. The size is great, it’s the size of a standard coffee mug plus a bit more. I like it!
